title: Final Electric Field
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric field inside the conducting shell for r < a.

title: Electric Field Outside
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the electric field outside the conducting shell for r > b.

title: Electric Field Inside
description: Important Criteria: The student must state that the electric field is zero for a < r < b.

title: Charge on Inner Surface
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the charge on the inner surface of the conducting shell as -q.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate the application of Gauss' law in deriving the electric field expressions.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes when calculating the charge on the inner surface.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the solution.
